### 2026-10-06 — # Devlog 2

**1.5h**

# Devlog 2

## I did today a LOT of wiring.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/B8T7ewFJxrNAGnjNP1kE2Akpi7xHYXxa/cd90b7b35b1bf4c7ce478fafeb409f81d81c482ecafb6d8212f7c5d8ff37ddba.png)

At first I deleted the rgb led, as it was wrongly connected. Maybe it comes back in the future. Then, I integrated an Microcontroller to USB IC, so that they can receife data/send data.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/B8T7ewFJxrNAGnjNP1kE2Akpi7xHYXxa/b25c342a0dc2d3fe3c038bf61dd20de5aae8ad4d53cec2449a575b38ef4f8124.png)

At next, I removed my Voltage divider because under high ampere usage, It May (Or may not) crash my Voltage. Now we are using an IC wich stablalises the voltage from 5V to 3.3 V

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/B8T7ewFJxrNAGnjNP1kE2Akpi7xHYXxa/ec42add96e2e5fba155c7166c0375584b59028e9377bc9a0c77fc07c43a76ecd.png)

Then, I researched what I should use for the Data transfer. I think I am going with this one:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/B8T7ewFJxrNAGnjNP1kE2Akpi7xHYXxa/0b97d5bea174fb9a050af72bd29dd9c733a24756edc958207a5845b6e42a2cac.png)

This should, as far as I know, connect it wirelessly to up to 200-300m. And then just Connect to an receifer module, wich will be plugged into an laptop via USB
